verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party 'Keyboard shortcuts' help article, so keyboard control is a documented capability, but the pack gives only the title and nothing on how comprehensive the shortcuts are. Several users call the web interface light and fast, while one notes the UI is a bit clunky because the email view reloads itself. missing for 10: evidence of comprehensive shortcut coverage (full keyboard-only operation), any command palette, measured or consistently corroborated no-wait performance.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait

citations.quote: The web interface is light and fast
Fastmail was a ton faster and didn't randomly forget my sessions.
